transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. As you know, we have a student-family reunification exercise coming up next Thursday following a simulated building evacuation. Before I can sign off on the final operating plan and we send the notice to families, I need to check in with each of you per our planning routine. I'd like to hear from the school nurse, facilities coordinator, transportation coordinator, and family liaison regarding the current draft. The draft currently uses the gymnasium as the reunification site, one transportation wave, an on-site medication table, and English-only pickup forms. Please share any concerns or updates so we can finalize this together.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a transportation concern with the current draft. I confirmed this week that the exercise group includes 96 students, and we have only one available 50-seat bus because the second bus is assigned to another school. Transportation policy therefore requires exactly two bus waves, but the draft still assumes one wave. We'll need to update the plan to reflect two waves before it can be finalized.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical facilities issue with the current draft. I confirmed this week that the gymnasium floor will be sealed and inaccessible next Thursday from 7:00 a.m. through the end of the exercise. The cafeteria is the approved alternate reunification site. I received the facilities work-order confirmation, but this closure has not yet been added to the exercise plan. We'll need to update the reunification site from the gymnasium to the cafeteria before the plan can be finalized.
